errors.text_span: Общият брой на категориите е шест.
errors.evidence: The pie chart clearly shows seven categories (slices), not six. The categories are 14-17, 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, and 65+.

errors.text_span: Най-големият сектор е обозначен като "65+", с бял цвят и заема около 20%.
errors.evidence: The largest sector (20%) is grey and corresponds to the '25-34' age group according to the legend. The '65+' group is 14% and is dark blue. The color is also misidentified as white instead of grey.

errors.text_span: Следващ по размер е секторът "14-17" с жълт цвят, представляващ приблизително 17%.
errors.evidence: The 17% sector is indeed yellow, but it corresponds to the '35-44' age group. The '14-17' age group represents 5% of the total and is blue.

errors.text_span: Секторът "18-24" с оранжев цвят е около 16%.
errors.evidence: The '18-24' sector is orange, but its value is 13%, not 16%. The 16% sector is light blue and corresponds to the '45-54' age group.

errors.text_span: Следват секторите "25-34" (син), "35-44" (зелен) и "45-54" (тъмно син), които съответно заемат около 15%, 13% и 14% от цялото.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple incorrect mappings. For example, '25-34' is grey and 20%, not blue and 15%. '35-44' is yellow and 17%, not green and 13%. '45-54' is light blue and 16%, not dark blue and 14%.

errors.text_span: Всяка секция има етикет, който показва възрастовата група
errors.evidence: The age group labels are located in the legend below the chart, not on the pie slices themselves. The slices only contain percentage labels.

errors.text_span: Сегментите са подредени по кръг, като техните размери изглеждат подредени по намаляващ порядък.
errors.evidence: The segments are not arranged in any discernible order by size. The values around the circle are 5%, 13%, 20%, 17%, 16%, 15%, 14%, which is not a descending or ascending order.
